title: On Founding a school for the village children
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：found　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 found 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the ranger ① founded a school for the village children in the rain, and every villager in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the ranger ② founds a school for the village children without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ found a school for the village children at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ founded a school for the village children before — a line in the survey for October 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Founding a school for the village children in the rain, the ranger said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ found the college on the old orchard without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Found the college on the old orchard at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the survey, and a new villager from the next valley ⑧ founds the college on the old orchard in the rain every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ridge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ founded a school for the village children again when nobody else would.

⑩ To found a school for the village children, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody founds a school for the village children without complaint again and somebody must found a school for the village children in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 创办（一般过去式 founded a school for the village children：1948 年守林人头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 创办（一般现在 founds a school for the village children：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 创办（不定式 to found a school for the village children：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 创办（过去完成时 had founded a school for the village children：1942 年十月的踏勘记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 创办（动名词 founding a school for the village children 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 建立在（found the college on the old orchard：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去建立在在一片老果园上建起那所学堂）
G. v. 建立在（found the college on the old orchard：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 创办（后段两处：新来的村民照例 founds the college on the old orchard，而母亲又一次 founded a school for the village children）

found 意为“建立在”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去建立在在一片老果园上建起那所学堂”，should ever 之后用原形 found the college on the old orchard。

found 意为“创办”，新来的村民每个季节都照例建立在在一片老果园上建起那所学堂，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 founds。
found 意为“创办”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨创办为村里的孩子办一所学堂，用一般过去式 founded 叙述。
found 意为“创办”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要创办为村里的孩子办一所学堂，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 found 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the ranger founded a school for the village children in the rain, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the ranger founds a school for the village children without complaint whenever the valley asks.
Founding a school for the village children in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever found the college on the old orchard without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new villager from the next valley founds the college on the old orchard in the rain every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother founded a school for the village children again, and the valley remembered that half.
